description: This file contains a custom React hook 'useNotes' that manages fetching, creating, updating, and deleting notes from a backend API.

methods.name: fetchNotes
methods.description: Fetches notes from the API and updates the local notes state.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note via the API and updates the local notes state.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note via the API and updates the local notes state.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note via the API and updates the local notes state.
